purpose: R2 launch-detector fixtures: real Robinhood Chain (4663) logs captured via public RPC (address-only eth_getLogs, 5k-block chunks, 1 req/1.5s), PumpPortal frames, and enrichment samples. Read-only evidence; no source files touched.

layouts.conventions: topics[1..3] are 32-byte words; addresses are the low 20 bytes (hex chars 26..66 of the topic / 24..64 of a data word). Data word N sits at byte offset 32*N. ABI dynamic strings: the head word holds a byte offset (relative to the start of data, or to the start of the enclosing tuple), the word at that offset is the byte length, the bytes follow left-aligned and zero-padded to 32. All amounts are raw integers (wei / token base units); quote-token decimals depend on the pair (USDG = 6, WETH/ETH = 18).

topics.2: curve (address; per-token contract that emits CurveBuy/CurveSell)

TokenCreated.note: same topic0 on both factory entries. problems: PumpPortal: only 11 create frames arrived across two 40s sessions (asked for 20) — feed rate ~8/min at capture time, both sessions closed at the 40s cap.
Flap LaunchedToDEX and Bags graduation were not observed in the window; their layouts remain unverified.
Pons unknown-308c390e / a0a18f5b and several curve/flap/bags auxiliary topics are recorded but unnamed (not in Bitquery docs).
Bags AMM buyer topic is the router, not the wallet — the wallet must be taken from the ERC20 Transfer in the same receipt.
Two earlier curve scans (scan-curve, scan-curves) missed the launch block because the window is head-relative; the fixture uses the third, fixed-span scan.
